reference.capBoundNote: The Rust bound drops the negative cubic term (16.2339); the independent tighter bound retains the left-endpoint cubic (16.1173). Both are conservative and below cap 100; neither is an explicit-stability bound.
initialRefusals: The unchanged quadrature agreement criterion refused the initial 4096-panel work cap; reference-only work increased to 16384 panels.
A centered derivative probe near a recently crossed face used three probe sizes (two halvings) before satisfying its original fine-probe bound. No fixture tolerance or physical law changed.

limitations: Full-domain total RMS need not decrease with time refinement because temporal and spatial errors can cancel; temporal field differences remain separate.
The 5 cm contour is nonmonotonic under grid refinement, including on independent exact integrated means. Control errors are not subtracted from physical errors.
